prompt:
Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1381
Claimant:
Suzanne Nelson
Adjuster:
Valerie Rodriguez
07/09/2023
Claimant reports a sideswipe while changing lanes and states that the other vehicle struck the driver's side as they
merged. Claimant is not represented by an attorney and has given a recorded statement.
07/17/2023
Policy confirms the driver is listed as a named insured and the vehicle is covered under the policy in force at the time
of loss. Nothing in the file suggests the damage predates the coverage start.
07/19/2023
Police report and two independent witnesses place the claimant inside the vehicle at the scene. Claimant reports
neck and back pain beginning shortly atfer the impact.
08/06/2023
Photos of the vehicle show dents on the passenger side, at a lower height than the contact point described by the
claimant. The damage pattern does not clearly line up with the account given so far.
08/11/2023
Reviewed a nearby business camera covering the stretch of road. The footage shows no contcat between vehicles at
the location and time reported.
08/17/2023
In a follow-up call, claimant now says the other car came from the opposite direction and that two passengers were
present. The first statement described a single occupant and a different direction of travel.
08/23/2023
Requested prior claims history for the vehicle and found no earlier damage recorded. Claimant also has no known
prior injury to the neck or back on file.
09/24/2023
Claimant was seen at an urgent care clinic and then referred to physical therapy. Clinic notes describe muscle strain
consistent with a side impact of this kind.
11/19/2023
Physical therapy notes show steady improvement over several weeks, with sessions becoming less frequent as
range of motion returned. Treatment appears to have followed a normal course for this type of injury.
11/27/2023
Re-interviewed the claimant about the camera footage and the discrepancies in the earlier statements. Claimant said
the recolelction of direction and passengers may have been mixed up due to stress after the event.
01/18/2024
Sent the vehicle damage findings and the footage summary to the damage review unit for an independent
assessment. Awaiting their opinion on whether the damage matches the reported impact.
01/29/2024
Current status: injury plausible for this type of crash, treatment tapered as expected, and coverage confirmed. Claim
remains open pending the damage review and a decision on the discrepancies in the camera evidence and the
claimant's statements.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
{"findings": [{"feature": "", "rating": "", "confidence": "", "quote": "", "reason": ""}]}
